_about: P7.2 logical zone catalog for the primitive-era valley. Existing VerticalSlice_C provides authored anchors only for the base camp, creek crossing/ford and lookout; the lake-swamp and mountain-pass positions remain unplaced until the final scene phase.

zones.name: Üs vadisi
zones.description: Başlangıç alanı; ağaç, taş ve su.

zones.name: Dere boyu
zones.description: Kil, kum, saz ve balık; dere geçişi başlangıçta riskli ve yavaştır.
zones.barrier_description: Deep creek with steep banks; the east ford is traversable at higher travel cost.

zones.name: Yüksek orman
zones.description: Reçine, boynuz, av, çakmaktaşı ve kök bitki tohumu.
zones.barrier_description: Steep slope and cliff terrace; the existing lookout stair stringers have no usable steps.

zones.name: Göl ve bataklık
zones.description: Kabuk, aşı boyası ve nadir baklagil tohumu.
zones.barrier_description: Soft swamp ground and lake water interrupt the foot route.

zones.name: Dağ geçidi
zones.description: Mevsimlik kaynaklar ve uzak keşif yeri.
zones.barrier_description: Snow, cold and travel distance; open travel window is seasonal.
